solution_simulator_01_description: A synthetic analyst evaluates demand across brands and retail areas: your store versus competitors.
solution_simulator_02_title: The batch arrives — and sells in time
solution_simulator_02_description: Model chilled-food deliveries on an Almaty map: factory → warehouse → stores, routes and batch sell-through deadlines.
solution_simulator_03_description: What-if scenarios for a product portfolio: raw-material price changes, competitor promotions, demand growth and a new market entrant.
solution_simulator_04_description: A food-market snapshot: volumes, production, capital raised and population coverage by region.
solution_simulator_05_description: AI Adviser dashboards: executive priorities, document flow and deadline monitoring without manual analytics.
solution_simulator_06_description: AI agents negotiate for a buyer and supplier: a discount request, calculation and interpretation of the response.
solution_diagnostics_01_description: The platform identifies conflicts between agencies, duplicated powers and functions that do not match their stated mission.
solution_diagnostics_01_feature: Transfer of functions to the private sector
solution_diagnostics_02_description: A comparative map of agencies: request volumes, assigned and out-of-scope functions, and external links.
solution_diagnostics_02_feature: One click from overview to profile
solution_diagnostics_03_description: An AI platform selects a talent pool from 50,000+ profiles by experience, competencies, rank and other parameters.
solution_diagnostics_04_description: Automated auditing of the public-service register and legislation to identify inefficient procedures and regulatory errors.
solution_diagnostics_05_description: A platform analyses employee data quality across government agencies, including demographic and professional characteristics.
solution_diagnostics_06_description: Cross-system data analysis identifies hidden affiliations, monitors fiscal discipline and assesses risks.
solution_diagnostics_07_description: Intelligent auditing of differences between a manually maintained HR system and an automatically updated system, including employee ID checks.
solution_coordination_01_description: Model the redistribution of functions and employees between agencies with instant workload and balance calculations.
solution_coordination_02_description: Evaluate candidates through video, voice and text analysis across 15 competencies, including reasoning, communication and resilience.
solution_coordination_03_description: A unified knowledge-access centre built on document-management and citizen-request data, with natural-language questions.
solution_coordination_04_description: A unified database of Kazakhstan's civil servants: tenure, previous workplaces and rapid candidate selection for vacancies.
solution_coordination_05_description: AI-powered Telegram and WhatsApp bots answer questions on a specified topic across multiple groups.
